environment: Node VM; actual source functions; synthetic in-memory storage and DOM; no browser end-to-end execution

tests.name: Local identity forgery
tests.expected: Session must require a valid login proof

actual.result: ID-only synthetic session accepted as Admin; password verifier never invoked

tests.name: Cash sale happy path
tests.expected: Stock 2->1, sale and linked movement saved

actual.result: Synthetic Cashier sale recorded as Admin User

tests.name: Interrupted checkout writes
tests.expected: Either all records save or none do

actual.result: Injected sale-write failure: stock=1, movements=1, sales=0; cart still present

tests.name: Interleaved checkout confirmation
tests.expected: Two purchases deduct twice or second request rejected

actual.result: Deterministic interleaving at confirmation: two sales and two Stock Out movements, stock=1 instead of 0

tests.name: Backup record schema
tests.expected: Negative stock and malformed record rejected

actual.result: Correct-envelope backup with negative stock / invalid price passed validation

tests.name: Backup checksum detects accidental edit
tests.expected: Changed data with old checksum rejected

actual.result: Changed stock with stale checksum rejected
Full valid return rejected because 100 gross refund exceeds 90 paid; collection computes quantity*original price

tests.name: Inventory handler fractional quantity
tests.expected: Apparel count must be whole number

actual.result: Direct actual handler call accepted 0.5 Stock In: 2 -> 2.5; UI constraint was bypassed in harness

tests.name: Period report refund semantics
tests.expected: October-only view distinguishes October refund from September sale

actual.result: October sale cohort=0, October refund events=1; actual summary Total Refunds=0.00. Cohort and event-date interpretations differ

tests.name: Reused product ID and return link
tests.expected: Old sale cannot match a different new SKU

actual.result: Actual lookup bound Old Shirt sale to New Cap by reused ID=2; delete/max+1 lifecycle is code-evidenced

tests.name: Recovery scope
tests.expected: System recovery preserves accounts and pricing settings or names exclusions

actual.result: Backup payload contains only products, categories, inventoryMovements, sales; users and settings excluded
